items.name: Coreboot / Libreboot
items.purpose: Open firmware alternatives; compatibility with this Razer hardware is unverified.

items.name: systemd-boot + systemd initrd
items.purpose: UEFI boot menu, generation fallback and systemd early boot.

items.name: USBGuard
items.purpose: Authorize USB devices through an explicit allowlist.

items.name: Lanzaboote + UKI / measured boot
items.purpose: Candidate for signed boot and measured unlock; requires firmware and key recovery planning.

items.name: TPM2 / FIDO2 unlock + pam_u2f
items.purpose: Optional disk unlocking and security-key authentication; no enrollment or PAM policy declared.

items.name: Boot & key recovery
items.purpose: Verify independent recovery media, encryption credentials and a known-good boot generation.

items.name: LUKS + Btrfs
items.purpose: Encrypted persistent storage with subvolumes, compression and checksums; ESP remains outside LUKS.

items.name: Disko + Preservation
items.purpose: Declarative disk layout and explicit persistence over a temporary root.

items.name: Snapper / btrbk
items.purpose: Optional snapshot scheduling, retention and replication; neither is configured.

items.name: Btrfs scrub + SMART monitoring
items.purpose: Scheduled checksum verification and drive-health monitoring; verify completed runs and alert delivery.

items.name: zRAM + encrypted disk swap + TRIM
items.purpose: Compressed RAM swap, disk overflow and periodic SSD maintenance.

items.name: Linux latest kernel
items.purpose: Track modern hardware support; retain a working generation when updating.

items.name: NVIDIA open driver · latest channel
items.purpose: RTX support and offload; runtime GPU sleep must be checked after workloads and resume.

items.name: Kernel mitigations + AppArmor
items.purpose: Kernel access restrictions and AppArmor support; enablement does not imply full profile coverage.

items.name: AMD microcode + PRIME / RTD3
items.purpose: Hardware-dependent and inherited settings; confirm effective options and runtime behavior.

items.name: Power Profiles Daemon + AMD P-state
items.purpose: Desktop power profiles and CPU energy preference; UPower supplies battery state.

items.name: TLP / TuneD / auto-cpufreq
items.purpose: Alternative policy backends; compare only if the current backend has a measured gap.

items.name: systemd service sandboxing
items.purpose: Kavita has explicit restrictions; service hardening is applied per service.

items.name: NixOS & Nix
items.purpose: Declarative builds, pinned dependencies and system generations.

items.name: Home Manager + sops-nix
items.purpose: User configuration and encrypted declarative secrets.

items.name: NetworkManager + DNSCrypt + firewall
items.purpose: Network connections, encrypted DNS and inbound filtering.

items.name: WireGuard tunnel
items.purpose: Secret material is prepared for NetworkManager import; an active tunnel is not established by that declaration.

items.name: sudo-rs + USB authorization
items.purpose: Rust sudo implementation and user-controlled device authorization.

items.name: BlueZ / Bluetooth
items.purpose: Bluetooth support with the radio disabled at boot.

items.name: OpenSnitch / nftables custom policy
items.purpose: Optional outbound application filtering or custom packet rules; no such policy declared.

items.name: Wayland + Mesa
items.purpose: Compositor display infrastructure and integrated-GPU graphics; confirm effective driver stack.

items.name: Wayland protocols
items.purpose: Follow HDR, color management, capture and scaling support; protocol availability is not feature acceptance.

items.name: PipeWire + WirePlumber
items.purpose: Audio/video transport and session policy; PipeWire is explicitly enabled.

items.name: Niri
items.purpose: Scrollable tiling compositor with an integrated-GPU rendering preference.

items.name: Noctalia v5 · shell, lock & idle
items.purpose: Launcher, notifications, system controls and session locking; verify lock and wake behavior.

items.name: Flatpak + nix-flatpak / Bubblewrap
items.purpose: Sandboxed app distribution with explicit filesystem allowlists and credential-path denials.

items.name: XDG portals + keyring + Polkit / user session
items.purpose: Desktop integration, credential storage, authorization and service lifecycle; verify actual routing and agents.

items.name: Steam / Proton + Xwayland-satellite
items.purpose: Gaming compatibility and X11 support under Niri.

items.name: nix-ld / external binaries
items.purpose: Runtime library compatibility inherited from external modules; inspect effective settings.

items.name: Gamescope
items.purpose: Optional gaming compositor and presentation controls; not declared.

items.name: nh + generation maintenance
items.purpose: Build, test, switch, search and retained-generation cleanup.

items.name: Zed · Java / C / C++
items.purpose: JDTLS with a project-provided Java runtime and built-in clangd support; project environments own build toolchains and compiler flags.

items.name: devenv + direnv
items.purpose: Native Fish environment activation with direct direnv loading in Zed; nix-direnv disabled.

items.name: nixd + nixfmt + statix / deadnix
items.purpose: Nix language support, consistent formatting and linting.

items.name: nix-index-database + comma
items.purpose: Candidate for finding and running commands without permanently installing packages.

items.name: nom + nvd
items.purpose: Optional build-progress display and generation package comparisons.

items.name: Pinned inputs + flake checks
items.purpose: Locked dependencies and configured flake checks; a declared check is not a recorded passing run.

items.name: Nix store optimisation + cleanup
items.purpose: Scheduled deduplication and generation retention.

items.name: Persistent journal, identity & keys
items.purpose: Retain bounded logs and selected machine/security state across ephemeral-root reboots.

items.name: Restic / Borg + restore verification
items.purpose: Independent encrypted backups and recovery drills; no automated backup job is declared.

items.name: vulnix / Trivy / Grype
items.purpose: Optional vulnerability scanning; results require applicability and false-positive review.

items.name: Rust in Linux / uutils + Landlock
items.purpose: Follow memory-safe systems work and unprivileged sandboxing; not a claim of deployment here.

items.name: GNOME ecosystem
items.purpose: Follow desktop, portal, graphics and accessibility developments relevant to the selected stack.

items.name: LibrePhone
items.purpose: Follow the FSF effort toward a free mobile software ecosystem; external to the laptop configuration.
